items.headline: Bo Nix, Broncos 'not freaking out' after mistake-filled loss to Chiefs
items.description: Denver Broncos quarterback Bo Nix said the mistakes were clear to see from Monday night's loss in Kansas City, but "we're not freaking out'' as the team prepares for Sunday's home opener against the Jacksonville Jaguars.

items.headline: Chiefs expecting rookie CB Mansoor Delane to play on SNF
items.description: Rookie cornerback Mansoor Delane, who aggravated a shoulder injury after recording his first career interception, is on track to play on "Sunday Night Football" against the Colts, coach Andy Reid says.

items.headline: Broncos face tough opening stretch, try to avoid slow start
items.description: The Broncos are 4-8 in September under Sean Payton after Monday's loss to the Chiefs. And they now face five 2025 playoff teams in a row.
